normalized.description: The SWORD Space Weather mission is targeting the provision of near-real time data on the status of Earth's radiation belts. To cover the full characteristics of the belts, a mission in a GEO-transfer type orbit is baselined. As space weather instrumentation is compact and requires low resources, as well as to ensure programmatic feasibility, ESA foresees as target a small satellite platform. The Phase A study shall assess the overall feasibility of the mission and cover the establishment of mission implementation plans (management, engineering, and product assurance), identification of technology pre-development needs, trade-off of system and operation concepts, derivation of technical requirement specifications and a thorough risk assessment.The procurement will be open competition to all industrial entities, ensuring an open competitive approach preparing further steps.
